title: Graphite Hatching
description: Croquis expressif au crayon traditionnel défini par des hachures diagonales rapides et audacieuses et des lignes de contour à pression variable. L'ombrage est réalisé entièrement par des traits parallèles sans estompage, laissant le grain du papier texturé visible dans les hautes lumières.
description_en: Expressive traditional pencil sketch defined by rapid, bold diagonal hatching and variable-pressure contour lines. Shading is achieved entirely through parallel strokes without blending, leaving the textured paper grain visible in the highlights.
description_fr: Croquis expressif au crayon traditionnel défini par des hachures diagonales rapides et audacieuses et des lignes de contour à pression variable. L'ombrage est réalisé entièrement par des traits parallèles sans estompage, laissant le grain du papier texturé visible dans les hautes lumières.
prompt: Traditional graphite pencil sketch on coarse textured paper. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. Rendered entirely with rapid, unblended diagonal hatching and bold, variable-pressure contour lines. Deep shadows built through dense, overlapping parallel strokes in {{accent_color}}, contrasting sharply with the bare {{primary_color}} paper used for absolute highlights. Midtones are achieved with lighter, precisely spaced graphite lines in {{secondary_color}}. The image MUST occupy the absolute ENTIRE dedicated space as a canvas rule: NO borders, NO frames, NO white margins, NO canvas edges, FULL BLEED to all four corners. The rendering technique relies purely on line density rather than smudging or smooth gradients, preserving a raw, academic life-drawing aesthetic. Tactile, granular pencil texture interacts visibly with the heavy tooth of the paper, creating microscopic breaks in the strokes. Edge treatments are raw and expressive, featuring loose, overlapping sketch marks, multiple search-lines for contours, and energetic directional hatching that bleeds off the boundaries of the composition. video.motion: Subjects animate with a stop-motion, hand-drawn cadence, updating at a slightly lower framerate to mimic flipping sketchbook pages.
video.camera: Static or slow, deliberate panning that allows the hatched shading to redraw dynamically as perspective shifts.
video.temporal_texture: The diagonal hatching lines and paper grain must boil slightly, with strokes rapidly redrawing and shifting position between frames while maintaining overall volume and lighting.
video.avoid: Smooth digital tweening, 3D camera sweeps, motion blur, or seamless gradient shading.
